parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to get the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 要查询资源发现的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the resource discovery belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the resource discovery instances. You can query up to 100 instances at a time
parameters.help_zh: 资源发现的实例ID列表。N的取值范围为1~100，即一次最多查询100个资源发现实例
parameters.name: ipam_resource_discovery_ids

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource discovery.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh:
资源发现的名称。

长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: ipam_resource_discovery_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource discovery.

The following types are supported:

system: a default resource discovery created by the system.

custom: a custom resource discovery created by a user
parameters.help_zh:
资源发现的类型。

当前支持的类型：
system：系统创建的默认资源发现。
custom：用户创建的自定义类型的资源发现
parameters.name: type

fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持64个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The value can be an empty string.

A tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。

一个标签值最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

If this parameter is set to Shared, the resource discovery is a shared resource.

If this parameter is set to Sharing, the resource discovery is being shared

取值为Shared时，表示该资源发现来自共享。

取值为Sharing时，表示该资源发现在共享中
